item.tib: gshen rab rnam par rgyal ba'i mngon rtogs 'dod 'byung nor bu'i 'phreng ba
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshul 'di ni/ dal 'byor phun sum 'tshogs pa'i btsun pa shes rab seng ges yang yang du bskul ba la brten nas/ mkhas btsun rnam dag 'od zer gyis/ bde gsal gsang phug tu dge sbyor gyi thun mtshams su bkod pa rdzogs so//
